verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents an official MCP server that exposes controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, risks and more as tools, so users can manage their data in natural language through an external AI client. The in-product Comply AI features are task-specific generation (policy writing and revisions, risk scoring), not a general command interface. Natural-language operation therefore depends on a third-party agent. Missing for 10: a native in-app natural-language command or assistant interface, documentation of which MCP tools can perform write or management actions, and independent or hands-on confirmation that natural-language operation works in practice.
